translation_error_percent.description: Ground-truth translation error normalized by the translation magnitude; this is the headline registration accuracy metric.

rotation_error_deg.description: Root-mean-square angular mismatch between transformed source-plane normals and target-plane normals on the scored slice.

plane_offset_rmse.description: Root-mean-square signed plane-offset residual after applying the predicted rigid transform to the scored slice.

num_planes.description: Number of input planes in the registration instance, reported as fixed problem-scale metadata rather than a ranked metric.
